protocol.sampling: Deterministic balanced cycling of predeclared regimes; no outcome-dependent selection/resampling. Same seed across tasks, cluster accordingly.
protocol.strata: Every fourth case is ordinary; remaining cases involve declared transitions/constraints.

pensim.provenance: Completed source batch endpoint; no receiving futures used.

physical_parameter_fit.provenance: Only the completed source_history supplied identically to both arms. No receiving labels.

mab.provenance: Completed source batch endpoint; no receiving futures used.

protocol.model_freeze: Existing coefficients/calibrations from the FIRST prior prediction case by catalogue order per process. No new fit or tuning. Operating input/state changes only.
protocol.claim_rule: All three primary aspects must exceed their useful-effect threshold with a cluster bootstrap95% lower bound above it, completion>=95%, and all cases scorable/admitted. Each process reported separately; no manufacturing claim.
protocol.power: Fixed bounded48/cases per process by default; exploratory, not a prospectively power-qualified definitive study. No optional extension until favorable.
protocol.failures: All selected seeds retained. Failed receiving KEEP/domain case is a coverage failure, blocks confirmation. Invalid selected action scores0. Correct abstention when grid has no feasible process action scores1, otherwise0.
protocol.observation_boundary: No receiving future, realization seed, action outcomes or scores returned. Source and receiving clocks separate. SMPL explicitly shares measured initial inoculum state across source/receiving; optimistic same-geometry test.
protocol.scope: PenSim96h partial process, SMPL24h upstream. Simulated transfer proxy, not vessel/site transfer. No real CHO data or real intervention in new suite.
protocol.known_design_findings: Earlier development found oxygen-floor artifacts and monotone SMPL action rankings. Fixed challenge grid includes admitted alternatives and explicit infeasibility/abstention; easy controls retained. No guarantee of decision diversity or B benefit.

failures.error: Original worker exited without a durable result; transport/runner exception. Unknown submission conservatively scored as failed; not rerun.

unavailable_audits.audit: SDK shared schema unavailable for failed session
Tool history unavailable for failed session

analysis_plan.timing: Written after inference started, before inspecting any new A/B scores or action choices; not an independently registered confirmatory protocol.
analysis_plan.primary_prediction: Prediction task only: equal mean of all six abs-error/source-history-median values per session, then mean over completed A/B session pairs per case. Primary benefit=1-mean(B)/mean(A).
analysis_plan.primary_decisions: Outcome and transfer tasks separately: assigned-arm decision_score, with failed/missing submissions scored0, average AI repeats within case. Score1 is best feasible product OR correct abstention if no process action is feasible; zero for invalid decisions/unnecessary abstention. Partial feasible product ratios lie0..1.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: 20000 paired whole-case bootstrap draws, deterministic seed20261028, keep repetitions nested. Report each process and ordinary/challenge stratum. Synthetic seeds are not biological replication.
analysis_plan.thresholds: Existing frozen dataset protocol: at least20% forecast-error reduction and at least0.05 operating-score and transfer-score improvement, each95% lower bound beyond its threshold. At least95% completion and no unscorable selected cases. No sample extension or selective target removal.
analysis_plan.forecast_failures: Numerical errors only exist for completed pairs; all failure denominators shown separately. Conditional forecast means are not unconditional real-world reliability.
analysis_plan.report_scope: Only this new experiment set provides the report's result tables. Prior studies remain linked historical evidence; no assertion that new simulated evidence invalidates or replaces earlier real CHO findings. All new results, failures, exclusions and known limitations are shown.

transport_recovery.pair_selection: One fresh A/B pair for every original pair containing exact Connection error. with no accepted decision. Not score-based.
transport_recovery.interpretation: Secondary paired infrastructure-recovery view, not additional independent cases or a preregistered successful first-run result.
